    The functorial filtration at a vertex #

    The valid half-words at (v, s), ordered by their codes, form an interval family on M_v (fam). Pairing the families of the two signs gives Ringel's functors F_{h,h'}(M) = (h⁺ ∩ h'⁺) / (h⁻ ∩ h'⁺ + h⁺ ∩ h'⁻) and the dimension formula dim M_v = Σ dim F_{h,h'}(M) (finrank_vsp_eq_sum).
